text: Bbq chicken Pizza and chicken parm were delicious!! Really enjoyed the food! Got it delivered through Uber eats!

One of my favorite Kebab/Gyro spots in town.  I get the #6 Gyro plate, tasty and plenty of food. Topped off with a bottled Coke, it can't be beat!  

Family owned and operated, this little gem is a standout compared to other food court offerings.  I'd come here even if I wasn't shopping.

Their baklava's the perfect finish!

Better than your standard pub food.

Service - 5 stars, attentive and dog friendly.

Food - Had the pretzel and cheese appetizer which was great.  Soft pretzel balls and a mini fondue cheese dip. The Pub burger hit the spot.  Cooked to order and not your lazy frozen patty burger which is all too common these days. Finally the Monkey Bread which is basically a deconstructed apple pie.  Moist, not too sweet and served a la mode. 

I noticed some fire places and a few games like corn hole in the back but didn't get a chance to check that area out.  Worth a stop.

An awesome atmosphere. While sitting outdoors and listening to the live music we enjoyed our food. The waitress was always quick to see if we need anything and to refill our cups. This was not to say that business was slow because it was not. I had the muffuletta and it left alot to be desired as it was not up to the one I had the day before. My wife and daughter had the burgers that was thick and juicy along with amazing frys. My son had the gator sausage po boy and he said it was amazing. A great place to relax have a drink and burger.

We finally stopped after seeing line ups every time we went by. Excellent! Fish and chips are the best we have had. Burgers are big and delicious. Fries were very good. Shakes were very good. If you order both, you won't need another meal for the day. Highly recommend, but don't tell anyone, the line will be longer.

This place is amazing! Stopped by while I was in town and loved it! The workers are very nice! The carne asada fried were with seasoned fries which made it very good! The mayan BBQ was amazing in a burrito

My friends and I came here on a Friday during lunch hours and it was not busy at all. The waitress was nice and the food did not take long. We ordered the Budae Jungol (1D) which consisted of pork, bean sprouts, rice cakes, ramen, kimchi, ham, sausage, and tofu garnished with watercress and enoki mushrooms. This hotpot was pretty big and could probably feed about 4-5 people. It also was not spicy at all, just very red from the red pepper paste and kimchi in the pot. The red does stain your clothes so I recommend you be cautious!  We also ordered the spicy pork over rice in a stone pot. The pork wasn't spicy, but was still good. Overall, the service was good, the food was delicious, and this is for sure my go to spot in chinatown if I am craving stew on a cold day. I believe this place is also the only place in chinatown that serves the korean hot pot.

Fresh food but someone in the kitchen was smoking cigarettes and you could obviously tell by the smoky smell of the restaurant! Plus, when me and my friend tasted our food it had a cigarette smoky taste to it! Not returning! I don't understand how you allow an employee to smoke cigarettes in your kitchen!! Of course the smell is going to be caught in the food and restaurant. Smh.

Wingers is a great place to go for lunch..  Though I haven't been here before, this is my 1st experience at wingers. I gotta say its fantastic. And even thats an understatement. 

The quality is pretty darn awesome. I recommend this place not just for the food but they also offer a great deal. One thing they do I give heavy props for is give you winger certificates for donating to JDRF which helps kids with diabetes I. I added a picture of it. 

Come here you wont be disapointed at all

First time I got beef fried rice and an egg roll and it was pretty good. Portion was enough for more than one meal. Next time I tried the sesame chicken and beef lo mien and literally threw it out. It was soggy and tasted almost spoiled. I won't be going back and have started placing bets on how long this place will be around. Sorry but I take my food very seriously.
We had a great time at Osteria. Amazing food and ambiance at a relatively affordable price.

Came in here with my boyfriend on a Friday night. We were seated along the back wall next to the kitchen which was kindof cool. The service and sushi were amazing.. love the ambiance in here. Only con was the price of the dinner.. but its great food!

The food was good, sauces not so great, and none of the meals actually come with a side. For $17.50 I got just meat and was an extra $6 for fries. 
Also came in with over half of the tables empty and still had to wait 30 mins. Service was not great either.

I wasn't really expecting to like this place.  I tend to get bored of ping pong pretty quickly.  I went with a party, maybe 20 people.  We had a section carved out for us, and had access to a little satellite bar.  I have no idea what was going on the night that we were there, but there was all sorts of free stuff going around.  Ice cream sandwiches from Big Gay Ice Cream, free drinks, some handed us a whole pizza.  It was strange... in a good way.  I am assuming that isn't typical, but even without all of that free stuff it was a good time.  I like that they don't seem to take the ping pong aspect too seriously, there were balls flying everywhere and the staff didn't bat an eye.  They even seemed to get a kick out of it.  

Lot's of instagramable stuff, I'm sure you've seen the tub.  If that's something you look for, there is plenty of it.

Went for lunch. Party of 6. Arrival time 11:30 am. We were sat in a corner which was fine but the gentlemen with the meat were sparse. Had to asked SEVERAL times for certain cuts (and never got them either). I think we tried only about 4 meats, sausage, sirloin, pork and flank. Where was the chicken, filet, lamb and the lamb chops? Well, the table next to use was served lamb chops twice. Our group of 6 had 2 small lamb chops to share. So not only was the experience not so divine they even charged my card twice by accident.  There was no set waiter or waitress either. Not a fan!
Exquisite menu ! Traditional yet remarkably unique! Wait staff are kind and attentive. Highly recommend to everyone! Try their clams casino ! Yummm

What a great little diner. Everything was so yummy! You can tell a great restaurant by how busy it is, and this place was hoping! Great service from the minute you walk in.. I wish I lived here, because this would be my weekly breakfast spot. They are open 24 hours, so they do have lunch and dinner options. We had breakfast and everything was delicious! Gonna have to hit this one more time before leaving Tampa. Dont miss out on this little gem..
Tried Lotus Bistro after hearing about outdoor dining options.  Treat to dine out amidst covid.  Extremely friendly staff.  Food fresh and well prepared.  Lovely lunch.  Will definitely return.

I just moved to Manayunk and this place was recommended to me so I figured I would give it a try during happy hour. Upon arrival, it wasn't very busy at all so it was easy to be seated. However, I have to point out that the happy hour is only honored in the bar and cocktail area. We ended up walking to the outside bar because the weather was beautiful. The place is honestly really big and welcoming. I can see it being a hot spot in the summer. I noticed a deck area that was closed down but I can imagine it would be a lot of fun to hang out with friends and drink by the river.

Once we sat down, we ordered drinks first which were a $1 off during happy hour. The beer list consisted of all their own beers. I opted to try the Monk From the Yunk which was a Belgian Tripel style beer. It was very good. If you've ever tried Victory Golden Monkey, it tastes just like it. After I finished that, I ordered their moscow mule. It was perfect for a mule and refreshening. I enjoyed it so much that I talked the person sitting next to me into getting it as well. 

For food, we ordered off of the happy hour menu. We decided to split the wings, the pizza, and a chicken quesadilla. The quesadilla and wings were both delicious. The wings were covered in a sweet, tangy sauce that made me craving more when I finished them. As for the pizza, it was pretty mediocre. If I could compare it to anything, I would say it tasted like a pizza lunchable. This leads me to believe that pizza might not be their

I've ordered for dine in and take out, multiple times since their opening in the summer of 2019.  Great food, consistently.  I love the spices that they add to their meats and sauces.  Prices are reasonable for portion sizes as well.

Got the pho, spring rolls, egg rolls and papaya salad. Enjoyed everything but the papaya salad was okay. I would recommend for their pho because it was so good!! Make sure to ask for sriracha and hoisin sauce!!

They never open time , food is fantastic good flavor but they are never ever on time , I got them to cater few times and they are great , food is always served hot but it seems they rely more on take outs and catering . They Should update and change operating hours on Yelp

For YEARS I've passed this place up going to the quarters and always wanted to pop in. SukhoThai did NOT disappoint. It was a last minute group decision that was made to accommodate a vegan friend. It's always a good feeling when everyone is able to enjoy a meal without having to settle.

The city has redone the off street parking on Elysian Fields to show love to the bikers of the city. It was a little strange to park so far from the curb, but none the less it was super easy to find parking on a late, muggy Sunday night. All the staff members were super friendly, helpful and professional. They all wore mask and would not come up to our table unless we had masks on. I appreciated their cautiousness. I also loved that they provided the table with a pitcher of water. Made it easy for us to not have to constantly put on our masks when they waiter needed to refill our water because Thai food can be hot hot hot. 

I ordered the drunken noodles with Indian bread. A great intro dish to Thai food if you've never had it before. Start low with the spice level, trust me. I strongly recommend ordering Indian bread with every dish.  nothing better than dipping and cleaning your plate at then of tour meal with some delicious homemade flat bread. Delicious.

My husband and I love this place! We are locals and try to make it in every couple of weeks. The servers are always friendly and the food comes out quick and delicious. Never disappointed with a meal here.

We love daily eats food, actually drove all the way from Sarasota to just go there. The reason why I can't give 5 stars is because of the service. Extremely slow, for it not being that busy- there was no wait, and not attentive. We were a party of 2, ordered one coffee and 2 simple meals. Food was brought out before we ever got the coffee. There was some kind of food photo shoot going on right in front of us and it took 4 wait staff members to attend to instead of customers. When I finally was able  to get someone's attention, not our waiter, and asked for a to go box, his reply (rudely)was "who is your waiter". All he had to do was grab me a box. Not happy!

Got our food.  The food was bad and dry.  Went up to the counter and asked for extra dressing.   Amanda "the manager"  rolled her eyes and was very rude. I asked her why the attitude,   she said go write a review my name is Amanda , or just deal with it. She said no matter what people will still come here.  I'm a big foodie, the food was 2 star at most.  Service was Terrible.  

*Super rude and not family friendly as I was holding my 2 year old niece *
* Armature works is great, just try the other food places there*

We ordered two pizzas. We love pizza and were really excited to try their unique take on Indian pizza. One was a paneer pizza and one was the aloo chaat pizza. They called to let me know that they were out of aloo chaat (spiced potato) and so I upsized the paneer pizza. They had already started the one so they gave us a second smaller but identical one to make up the difference, which was stand-up and a good resolution.
I think they must have also been out of paneer, too, as there was none on either pizza. We thought that it might have been crumbled and part of the sauce but the photos all show regular paneer chunks on the pizza. After expecting chunks of paneer on pizza this was really disappointing. Maybe, they were waiting on a product delivery and we just ordered at the wrong time?
That said, even though the pizza all we expected, the flavor was really good. The dough, sauce, fresh toppings- are all great! We plan on ordering again in the hope of trying the paneer pizza and aloo chaat pizza.

I used to love this place but the last two times I've gone it's gone significantly downhill. This round we were seated in their "converted patio" area. To say the least it was FREEZING cold. The salad bar this time was okay at best. All of the meat was over cooked, dry, over salted, or severely undercooked. Not a good experience.
If you want to find the city's most delicious breakfast.. look no further. The Sausage and Gravy Kolache is probably the most delicious thing I've ever eaten. You won't be sorry!

I have been here several times. Tonight we had a 3 person reservation at 7 PM.  Checked in right at 7 and waited for about 25 mins. Went in and there was an open table at the bar. At no time was I advised that my table was ready for the entire meal. I ordered with my family and the food was cold when we got it. Lots to improve here before we will be back. No thanks

I love coming here for their crepes!  They have buckwheat (gluten free) and sweet crepes.  They are fine with substitutions.  Sandwiches can have gluten-free bread for a sight upcharge. The cashiers/servers are very personable. The setting is warm and welcoming  Some of the food choices are a couple of dollars higher than a person like me on a limited budget, but otherwise you won't regret your visit.

Either this location is new or renovated. It's beautiful. I threw dietary caution to the wind and got the Prosperity sandwich - an open-faced roast beef sandwich with garlic butter, gravy and St. Louis style cheese (guessing provel). Absolutely delicious. I balanced things off with a Diet Coke and am looking forward to visiting again. Thank you!
Our waiter was Phrank and he made some great recommendations for food and drinks. Meal was delicious and fresh, and views from the top floor were great during sunset

if you like your philly cheesesteak with chopped meat, go elsewhere. This place is for the other crowd that either don't have a preference or just like the meat in its original size the way its laid on the grill for cooking.  In little thin medallions of beef pleasure.  Its one of the old guard like Pat's, Geno's & Jim's.  Great Philly Cheesesteak.  I love mine with hot sauce and Hot Italian cherry peppers.  The establishment is a local fave.  No where near downtown Philly tourist areas.  Its located in NE Philly.  Enjoy.

Your money doesn't not go a long way at all here. It was $15+ for a one topping medium pizza, only 8 very small slices. Compared to other places, not very cost effective. Not sure if I'll be coming back.

I usually don't venture from my typical spots for Taco Tuesday but I was feeling a little adventurous this week so I decided to try this new place!  Upon entering you had to stand in line to place your order. The entrance of the restaurant may not look very impressive, but their yard and outdoor seating create a great ambience. 

It's a great place to go grab a drink on a warm day and hang out with friends.  Unfortunately, I wasn't able to enjoy a drink myself but from what I heard they are not good, but not quite worth the price.  Now for the tacos...overall they were quite average. I am a fan of chicken tacos so I went with those. I'm one to pour a generous amount of sauce on top for some extra flavor but I wasn't very impressed with their selection.  The tacos were on the drier side overall in my opinion.  I would say in comparison to other places in the city, there's better out there. 

Overall, I'm glad I tried this place, but for now, I'm going to have to stick to my usuals!

This is the worst experience I've ever had.  The pizza had about 12 slices of pepperoni on the pizza.  All the ingredients were roughly  in the middle of the pizza.  The rest was just crust.  This is unacceptable.
The corn was amazing it blew our minds... We could have just had that as our main entree but then to top it off the stake tacos chicken tacos pork tacos nachos a mind blowing experience.

We are long time fans of your Shreveport restaurant and hoped that our first visit to the New Orleans location would be equally impressive.  Sadly, no such luck.  Food was good, but management is severely lacking.  In the midst of our meal, a porta pottie just out side the restaurant began to be emptied and the smell of raw sewage filled the restaurant.  Neither management nor our waiter mentioned this.  We asked to move to another location in the restaurant due to the smell and did, but received no apology from management nor any offer of a full or even partial comp.  The self-proclaimed Maitre'd even came to our table after we moved and asked how our meal was.  I told him my wife could not finish her meal due to the odor.  His response..."Thanks for coming in" and he walked away.  I've never been in the restaurant business, but I would have been falling all over myself apologizing and comping people.  Sorry, sorry management.  Don't eat here.  They do not appreciate customers.

Coffee is good, their WiFi sucks. Don't expect to come here and be productive. There are only two spots to connect your laptop, so it doesn't seem lingering is encouraged. That, the minimal parking,  and the fact I've been staring at the "loading" icon for extended amounts of time gives me that impression. 

I ordered the red-eye and so far no complaints. The drive thru is run relatively efficiently so if you're just gonna get your caffeine fix then you should be fine.
Awesome Cuban sandwiches and tasty ice cream. We each tried a different sandwich and each of us loved it. The chips and guacamole were also a nice touch. Will definitely be back for more.

Awful experience AGAIN!  Not sure why we gIve it a chance. Went in after 8 tonight, one of three tables. Waitress was great drinks, wines, salads, soup all in good timing. Took over an out to get our entrees, sautéed spinach wasn't even wilted, no prosciutto on the pork saltimbucca  , no prosciutto! The waitress was explaining it took so long because that had to cut the pork I could have broke down an entree pig in that amount of time. I don't like to go here but, my husband and I are both food professionals, he a graduate of the CIA, combined experience of 60 years, total disgrace tonight, and they weren't even busy at all. Done, they have been floundering for years now, it will be sad  when they close but, very deserved. Followed up on their contact page on website, THEY ONLY LET YOU USE SO MANY CHARACTERS! Had to shorten what I wanted to say. Very frustrating company.

Went here for the Patriots vs. Cowboys game and the service was horrible.  Second floor was not busy and took a half hour for the waitress to bring our drinks after ordering.  They did not have two food items we ordered and the food we had was mediocre.

I have been coming to La Bonne Bouchee for as long as I can remember!! Their desserts are phenomenal, and my family frequently orders cakes for various occasions (the raspberry cake is a favorite.) If you haven't already visited, I truly recommend this place! Their reputation for incredible deserts is very well deserved.
Very good, the hot sauce was my favorite thing and the plate was big enough to feed 3 people.

Overall nice place with a convenient location, but not worth a long wait for brunch.

Coffee-
Their lattes are just ok. They really burn the beans and you can taste that. Avoid the Vanilla Bean & Salted Caramel flavors. They are pretty tasteless. The Lavender & Honey flavor is the best option of the ones I tried. Love that they have the option for Oat Milk but were sold out of it on Sunday around 1pm.

Food- 
Order the Sourdough French Toast, it's good & great for sharing. It comes with three large slices and I'd suggest the side of fruit over the potatoes. 
Order the Hot Mess with a side of home fries, but only if you don't mind spicy. The pepper jam is pretty hot. 
Pass on the Fig & Prosciutto Toast. The olives overpower all of the other flavors. You can barely taste the fig or prosciutto.

Pastries-
The Strawberry Pop Tart is excellent! Take one to go.

We were told about Beaut Burger by our son and it was great!!

The burgers were wonderful and we got sweet potato fries and regular fries.

They are pet friendly and we have brought our Blue and Gold Macaw Sunshine.

Great prices, wonderful and delicious vegan food and a super atmosphere!!

We will definitely be back!!
Outstanding service, excellent food, and very reasonable prices all add up to a great dining experience.
Stopped in for lunch and had the crab meat grilled cheese sandwich. They used Italian cheeses and it was unbelievable and filling.

Ordered here for my sons birthday dinner and it didn't disappoint. Had the jerk wings, jerk chicken egg rolls, Koren pork, shredded jerk chicken , fried plantains  and rice and beans.  Everything was excellent. Even played a little Bob Marley at dinner. Ordered online and food was ready when I arrived. Definitely will be back.
My daughter, wife, and I love coming here, food is very good, fresh, my daughter loves their Mango Smoothie, and as a veteran family we get to support our local veteran businesses.

This is my new favorite spot. I ordered Banh beo, Mi Quang, Com ga hai nam, and they're so amazing. It was delicious. Normally I always feel a bit salty at most of other Vietnamese restaurants, but this place doesn't. Everything is perfect. Absolutely come back multiple times.

If I've been here once, I've been 30 ish times. We've ordered the tacos (both kinds), burritos, the ceviche, quesadillas, and shrimp cocktail so I feel pretty confident about writing about this little truck.  We've taken most of Swedish family here as well Bc food trucks are a big thing in Sweden.

Tucked in a parking lot behind a gas station, it's easy to drive by this place. My favorites are the shrimp cocktail and the ceviche which come in 3 sizes. The boy child gets the traditional tacos and he wolfs down the 4 pack.  Hubs loves the burrito and he typically gets the al pastor.  

This is no frills, tasty food delivered with a smile.  Go here. Eat good food and thank me later.
Everything we had here was amazing!!  However the drunken shrimp was by far the best!  We had it three time while on vacation for a week!!

Wow wow wow!!!  I hesitate to write this because they could easily raise the price once they realize what a gold mine they have in their charming staff and phenomenal faire but it's selfish of me to hide their light under a bushel. Choose whatever you'd like and you will find yourself in heaven. The curry, the paht tie, the tea (orange and sweet?!  Took me by surprise then made me fall in love) the katsu don ... nothing disappoints and all are both inexpensive and wonderful!

I came across Rockstar Pizza searching for keto options in the area. I wasn't sure what to expect, but was excited to try. Once entering, the employees were nice and helpful. A young gentlemen helped me order a pepperoni keto pizza (comes in size med only). Once getting the pizza, I noticed it smelled like the keto pizzas I've been making at home. That assured me that it was indeed keto. The first 2 slices weren't bad, but by the time I got it home it wasn't good as I still have leftovers. One thing I've found out about keto pizzas is they generally need to be eaten while hot. I examined the crust and it def looked like my homemade one. With that being said for the price of $17 I will continue to make my own at home and alter the toppings as I need too (sauce was lacking). If you're not one to make your own and want something quick this is the way to go. I may be back to try the keto breadsticks or the desserts.

I finally tried this place after having this one my "to try" list for almost a year. The night we went, the line up was long and went out the door but it was a nice night out and it was nice to see so many people out. The service I found it to be a little slow but they also had a lot of demands from Uber Eats, Door Dash and such so I could see that they were very busy. Their burrito portion sizes were very big! They were very generous on their portions. A little on the pricier side but compared to other sushi burritos and poke bowls, I guess this was in line with prices for similar food around this area. I would go back.

This my favorite Penn Station. I think we all know what a Penn Station subs are as food but which I think is amount the highest quality sub shop. But this place is outstanding for service and cleanliness. They are always checking if you need anything and other than at the busiest times will will clean off your empty trays. Workers regularly clean the drink and condiment station.

Asa plus the store seems to have much brighter lighting than others.

This pizza is excellent. They do something magical with the crust and the toppings... like wizards... magical pizza making mystery chefs... get a philly roma and pair it with a Yuengling and get ready for perfection!

Worst experience we have had in Reno so far.  I placed a reservation for this restaurant because we were excited to try their beers.  Unfortunately it seems like they took too many walk-ins and therefore we had to be seated in a separate "bar" area.  I say "bar" because we were seated in what looks to be a convention room.  I would NOT recommend making reservations to this restaurant because apparently you'll have better luck with just taking a chance and walking up.

So, this was our first time going to yard house and we had a 45 minute wait to be seated. Once the time was up we all order burgers my wife had burger with sweet fries and they where still frozen inside, I ordered my burger with onion rings and the where cold but lucky not frozen. So the server took my onion rings away and brought back fresh hot ones within a minute! But my wives sweet fries took 10 minutes to comeback and they where hot but not crispy. The burgers where good and the service was good but it's crazy how a restaurant can't get hot fries or onion rings. The prices kinda high for a burger $13+ but you get frozen sweet fries for $1 more.. lol.. the place is too dark and especially in the bathrooms where light is important trying to see if someone left something behind. Another change Restaruant..

Everything about this place is amazing.
The service is phenomenal. They go above and beyond to make sure everything and everyone is taken care of. 
The food is great! I love sandwiches and the turkey avocado here was amazing.

Food was great and the atmosphere was colorful and vibrant. Our waiter checked in often and we never had to wait too long to order or get drink refills. Servings are large and everyone loved their food!
My server was pleasant, but my flour tortillas wasn't so good, it was pretty hard but my server was quick about changing my flour tortillas.
The food had good flavor, but was on the pricey side.  Liked the atmosphere, and would have liked a menu with more pasta options.
Traveling an don the road and wanted some Laotian soul food. This hit the spot!! It's a must for anyone craving good, Lao food. A restaurant and and a market. What more do you need?!

They advertise unlimited toppings, but the girls making the pizza's are super stingy with the toppings...she would barely cover the pizza with veggies.
Pizza's were poorly sliced, my wife had a few trapezoidal shaped slices...who works at a pizza joint and doesn't know how to use a pizza slicer?
My cousin got fresh mozzarella, but only half of her pie was covered with cheese!
There are way better build your own pizza options out there. If you're looking for value head somewhere else!

First time here and it was fantastic.  I ordered online and I got there when it was supposed to be ready and it was on time.  This during a Covid 19 situation and it looked clean and they were taking precautions to ensure cleanliness.  
I got the turkey and pulled pork plate and it was excellent! Fresh and good portions.  The fries were amazing as well.  
No wonder all the ratings are great.  Great experience all-around and I will return!
Great food and a lively atmosphere. The lettuce wraps were a great appetizer and the fried chicken meal was great. Everyone loved their food.

My boyfriend and I came here while on vacation from Houston. We had a great time, and had absolutely wonderful service from Alex! She suggested great drink choices and was super attentive! The general manager Jason even stopped by our table to say hello during our time there. We definitely look forward to coming back during our time in town, and visiting again!

absolutely HORRIBLE. dont say youre open 24/7 if you close at 10pm. also the woman at the drive thru called me racial slurs and other profanity. their fries are the worst also and it stinks in there BAD. also they never give me the sauce that they CHARGE ME FOR AND I MAKE SURE I ASK FOR

Mediocre and expensive fast food Mexican. Three tacos are being charge by the unit. I could get a nice slab of steak for that price. The salsa bar is good and the pico is a great addition to the otherwise blend burrito. Make sure to ask for an extra napkins.

I'm glad I made it to Kilroy's in Broad Ripple to hang out and have some beers.  My friends and I came to watch the Pacers game and Ball state game.  It is a nice space with a huge bar area.  I did notice they only had 6 top tables and not that many small tables with 2 seats, which I'm sure was because of Covid-19,  but some of my friends found it discouraging.  The drink specials were great and we took advantage of them with the $2 Miller lite and coor's light.   I ordered the smoked chicken and artichoke panini with tater tots for lunch and it was delicious!!  Our server was awesome and gave us wonderful customer service.    They have plenty of TV all around the bar which made it easy to watch the game. All in all, Kilroy's is a great place to hangout and watch a sports game. Their stuffed breadsticks are amazing!!  They have a variety of long Island cocktails and bombs which are supposedly very good.   I will have to try one the next time I go to Kilroy's.   This is a great place!!

UPDATE 12/30/19: 
As we frequent Taquito's on average about weekly, after a year of enjoying their cuisine - we still love and rave about their food! We simply can't get enough of their authentic, hot, fresh and crunchy Latin fare. We highly recommend giving it a try! Directly across from the Bay Pines Va next door to Dragon Phoenix Chinese Restaurant TAQUITOS can be easily found.
We're plant based eaters and love the "El Vegetariano" Bowl w/Chips and usually add a side or two. Recently we tried the ELOTÉ Mexican Street Corn and LOVED IT! We wonder WHY we hadn't tried it sooner...
I like wearing a provided Sombrero listening to the festive music while creating our own personal Fiesta! Adding a family friendly staff, this place is one of those "HIDDEN GEM'S"!

Fifteen years later, I still look back on my visit to Pizza King Station as one of the greatest experiences of my life. Looking at the photos, it hasn't changed one bit, and I salute each and every employee.

One of the best if not the best restaurants in Reno. Mason was our waiter did a great job there but not in your face ,nice . We had French toast for an appetizer really good a must . Then eggs  Benedict and the corn beef hash tasty and hot . So if in Reno or live here it is the best !

Worse Taco Bell in St. Louis and we've never been back this was our last time there and it was on the weekend weekend of Easter one of the workers made fun of my parent's first name. All the workers do is play on there phones and act completely stupid in front of the customers. And the drive thru is the worst.

I honestly can't tell you how the food is because they cancelled BOTH time when they were schedule to come to my work. The first time they cancelled it was about 10 minutes before they were suppose to start serving. The second time was today and they cancelled due to an "accident" even though they were already at my work.
I really like the spinach dip. I also ordered the shrimp and grits, which were amazing!! Great service and great food

The ambiance is cool, it seems family friendly, waitstaff is nice, but this food is so underwhelming. It's a chain but the prices are crazy high for such a basic place... ex $15-20 for omelets, etc. I think our total was $35, which i think is pretty high for breakfast. 

The food portions were tiny, it was pretty bland. First time there, won't be back.

We were visiting family here in Fishers and happened this restaurant yesterday. We ordered a variety of foods and shared. We were not disappointed. We decided we needed to come back today for brunch and ordered different menu items to share again. There are just so many excellent choices. We again were not disappointed. We had the same waitress both days (Darlene). She was awesome! She needs a raise! . All of the staff were very pleasant.
Orgasmic!!! Love this place!! If you are ever in the morthen part of tucson and wanting some great mediterranean food then Pita Jungle is the way to go!!! You canr beat great prices and great food!!

Beautiful, upscale rooftop bar! I'm here anytime I happen to be in the st pete area, and I always enjoy myself! The happy hour selections are a pretty good variety, and the staff is friendly. Good drinks and a view?? What more could you ask for!?

They are all f-ing high. Was funny until the guy at the second window didn't say a word and after he handed the order just walked away with a cold shoulder as we tried to ask a question . Was funny too until we got home and the food was wrong.

Provisional 5 stars (only ate here once...today...).

Was planning to go to Ting Wong with someone and didn't quite make it there (that's another favorite in Chinatown). Pretty similar menu here to Ting Wong but has more Americanized Chinese dishes. Small place even by Chinatown standards, having about 6-7 tables. Service is pretty friendly by Chinatown standards too.

Had the following items at our table: Small Wonton Soup (pork only inside), house special fried rice (chicken, egg, pork, and shrimp), half a Peking Duck, and soy sauce chicken appetizer size (1/4 chicken). Everything was excellent, other than the soy sauce chicken (which was merely pretty good; prefer Ting Wong's by a decent bit).

But in any case, perhaps the best fried rice I have had in my life with everything cooked really well and the rice being nice and dry. Wonton soup had a slight spiciness to the broth and a pretty good tasting broth (pretty light in feel). Peking Duck was outstanding and more or less among the best I have had. Included some fat for texture, but mostly not fatty tasting.

I had a friend visiting from out of town and asked for suggestions of a place to eat in Goodlettsville near his hotel. A number of people suggested Chef's Market, and it did not disappoint! The staff was friendly and helpful, the food all looked terrific, and the selections I ordered were delicious. I got the Mansker Meatloaf, which was moist and flavorful, along with the rosemary potatoes and the buttered corn, both of which were excellent. My friend got the Yankee pot roast, green beans, and macaroni and cheese, and he was equally satisfied with his meal. I also had the fruit tea, which was tasty and satisfying. I was too full for one of the enormous layer cakes, but I did have a chocolate chip cookie filled with chocolate chips; it was recently out of the oven, and wonderful. I don't get to Goodlettsville often, but if I need to eat there again, this will be my first choice.

We were looking for a restaurant with good German food in the area and came across this place. What a hidden gem. The outside doesn't look like much, but the seating on the waterfront is perfect. Great authentic German dishes including excellent spatzle. The wursts are all quite tasty, my husband ordered the Best Of the Wurst platter and we all tried a sample of all the different wurst.  The only disappointment was that they were out of rouladen. The service was quick but unrushed and friendly. The mix of Jimmy Buffet and traditional German music  in the background was perfect! We will definitely be back.

Habit Burger is one of my go to spots when I want a great burger! The facility is always clean and the staff is always accommodating and super friendly. The menu is short, sweet, and to the point, but I believe everyone will be able to find something on the menu they will enjoy. My favorite burger is the Santa Barbra Char! I can tell my burger is made to order with fresh ingredients.

4.6/5

This place was really good when I went! I went with a larger group so we shared several things. My favorite was the vegetarian combo, especially the spinach and lentils. While not standard ethiopian fare (I think?), the crisp lightness of the salad was a nice contrast to the rest of the food and kinda of served like a palate cleanser between bites.

It was interesting how they dolloped each of the types of food across the injera -- it made for a pretty pattern, though the food also mixed together more easily.

My only complaint here was our server.  She was pushy about wine, appetizers and dessert.  She asked over and over again like she had forgotten she had just asked.  Otherwise the food was amazing and yum for that bread!!

Chill bar to pop into for some afternoon sports watching. It is a nice open space with plenty of beer options. We ordered a few food items and were not disappointed. The impossible burger exceeded expectations and had a lot of flavor. The fried pickles were delicious with the dipping sauce. Overall would return to watch another game.

For the price & amount of food you get, this place is pretty solid for a local pizza joint. Their cheesesteaks were actually pretty solid & I loved how spicy the hot peppers actually were. The only thing that bothered me is how none of the employees seemed to know how to properly wear a mask? Especially in a food establishment... during the height of COVID? If you're prepping food, the least you can do is keep your customers safe by masking up. I don't know how they get away with violating the state mask mandate since it doesn't seem like I'm the first person to complain.

I wanted to try a new place in hopes of gaining a new favorite Chinese place. I was looking forward to it being delicious based on the pictures and reviews but now. The rice was dry and not fresh. The general tso chicken was hot but it did not taste like quality chicken at all. The meat was brown on the inside, tough, and hard. Not appetizing at all. The crab Rangoon was decent but too much imitation crab.

Nice restaurant in the New Orleans area, it was walkable distance from my hotel but I most say a bit pricey. The three times we went there cost about $60 for a party of two and we both had breakfast. The service is pretty good tho, and my personal favorite is the French toast.
I ordered fish and chips. Battered fish was so good and crisp with tartar sauce. I was disappointed with chip and salad side. Salad side was soggy and old. Chip tastes not fresh and not y- potato!

We had a Birthday dinner here for my daughter. We were a party of 10 and sat at the hibachi grill. The service was excellent and the chef was very funny and entertaining. The food was very good and plentiful. I got the steak and it was cooked perfectly. We even got a free meal since we had a bday and a party of more than 5. They were running a special.

This place is amazing. I am not sure why it only has a 3 star overall rating. Quaint, family run business with delicious Italian entrees. If you are looking for spaghetti and meatballs this is not for you, but if you are looking for homemade gorgonzola gnocchi or mushroom ravioli, this is the place for you!!!  Fresh ingredients. Flavorful entrees. Gorgeous ambiance. Friendly waitstaff. Highly, highly recommend. P.S. bring your own wine....no cork fee.
Taco Bell. If you're after consistency this place delivers whether you're in a meth riddled small town in Pennsylvania or New Mexico,  you can always count on terribly consistent food

Can i put zero stars? Had a group of 7 waiting for an hour, as we were getting seated a lady walked up and gave the hostess $150 for the table... needless to say we got put back on the wait list. So the hostess then lied about giving our table away even after recieving a text that our table was ready. Even after calling her out about it she did nothing to keep the business. Believe, this was a bachelor party weekend we would have spent well over the pocketed $150 by the lady hostess with dark rimmed  glasses and long dark hair working around 5:45 pm at the door AND it would have profited the BUSINESS, NOT the hostess.

I had the marinated mushrooms stir-fry, with the onions and peppers, curry cauliflower, salmon over quinoa.. DELICIOUS was an understatement. Had to order two of the raw cold pressed juices bcuz it was just that good. It's my second time at this restaurant and I can't get enough! I'll be back again soon!

Excellent food, relaxing atmosphere and really friendly staff. There aren't many Thai restaurants in the area so I'm happy I discovered this one. The Panang Curry and Thai Dumplings were delicious. Can't wait to come back!

So good! I had been here when on a visit with friends and this trip to Nashville I brought my husband. He looked at the menu and then asked me why nothing had meat (HAHAHA) before he realized it was a vegetarian restaurant. He was able to get regular cheese so he was happy about that. He loved his burrito. I had the quinoa veggie bowl which besides being a tiny bit too "dry" was awesome. I also had the local "booch" kombucha and it was tasty. Our waiter was super friendly and helpful. There was definitely a lunchtime rush happening right around when we got there but by 2pm or so it was thinning out and the rush didn't seem to affect our service.

Okay, I have been here once for the hot pot and twice for the bubble tea. This place is meant for hot pot I believe and not the bubble tea, so I don't blame them for not having the best boba of course.

I'm gonna start off with the bubble tea since I love my bubble teas. It comes in one size, and the size I believe would be considered a "large" in normal bubble tea restaurants; therefore, the pricing for the one sized bubble tea is pretty fair and comparable to other bubble tea places in the area. They have a decent varieties of bubble teas, but the taste wasn't the best and not very consistent. I tried the Rose Matcha Latte and Old Plum Juice and Lemon twice. The first time was not bad, but when I went again the next day, both drinks tasted a bit bland or water down. Not sure if this is because they were still in their soft opening phase, and they are trying to figure out measurements or if it is the person making it. I could come back again though to try other varieties, since it isn't bad for the area !

On to the food ! We ordered the Curry flavored and Cheesy milk, both cost $14.99. This place is not your typical AYCE hot pot, so it comes with set items with your soup base. For the price, I think the amount of food you get isn't a lot. It may look like a lot, but the bowl/pot it comes in is actually pretty shallow. The taste was mediocre at best. I did not enjoy the curry flavor, but the cheesy milk flavor was interesting. The soup base tasted very light, and there aren'

Good South Indian food. Good ambience inside. Nice and clean
Need more staff to get the food delivered on time

I liked their very noticeable sign from Gateway blvd so I made a self note to try this place out. Server was friendly and courteous. Food was good overall. I did tell them I was going to give them a review so we were given a free dish of green onion cakes which were actually quite excellent. The Miso soup was great also. Over 100 choices in the menu so I got kind of lost on what I wanted. 3.8 out of 5.

I rolled in here before I went off outside of town for a hotel we had just booked, we wanted some real food as opposed to fast food and found this place via Yelp. I'm glad we did roll in here, the food was tasty, very fresh, the service was friendly and the kid running the cash register was super nice. I liked the food very much, good flavor . I will definitely return when I'm back in Reno . Very affordable also .

I ordered a cheese pizza and mac & cheese bites from Franzone's and was disappointed in both. I couldn't finish the pizza because it tasted so bad and it had no flavor. The dough had no crunch, the sauce was too sweet and the cheese was bland. None of the ingredients tasted fresh either. The mac & cheese in the mac & bites also had no flavor and had too much breading. 

I compared different pizzerias near me to see where I wanted to order from and Franzone's pizza was about $3-4 more expensive than the other pizzerias. Unfortunately, I will not be a repeat customer.

This was my family's first time ordering pizza here and we had a very positive first experience! We ordered pizza and fries which were both done when we arrived. Their staff was very friendly and quickly gave us our order. The fries were crispy and they weren't wet and chewy which had been a problem at some places for my family. The pizza was perfectly cooked-not too overdone or lightly cooked. Everything tasted amazing and we will be coming back soon! I 100% recommended coming here and if you do you are supporting a local business.

Extremely disappointing take out tonight. The burrata salad was missing the burrata and the pizza was ice cold.Their wings are delicious but the service both in the restaurant and at take out is terrible.

We visit pass a grill every time we come to St Pete's Beach, and this place is the reason why.  They are known for their famous Grouper sandwich and roof top bar. The view from the top floor bar is amazing and should be visited. The Grouper sandwich has always been my favorite.  This last visit was a little different!  We ordered two Grouper sandwiches and ate them at the bottom floor outdoor bar.  They seemed smaller than usual, buns were stale and chips where soggy and cold. Bartender  was good and on her own reordered the chips which were better.  I hope we just visited on an off day.  But beer was enjoyed after lunch on the top roof bar, met some great folks and shared laughs!  This place has always been a solid 4 star, this visit it was a 3.0 on food alone! Servers and bartenders are good and the place is still a fun stop...But hope they are not sliding!

Solid 4.5 stars in my book. I've never been to the location since I ordered through doordash for the first time today but I was happy with my order. I ordered an iced latte (4.25) a turkey egg and cheese croissant (6.25) and to meet the minimum a vegan banana coffee cake muffin (4.25). The total was a little over $18 so yes, it's kind of pricy but for delivery I was willing to pay. 

The sandwich was definitely homemade so you're not getting any of that fake egg stuff. It arrived warm and my iced latte was still cold and not melted. The banana bread coffee cake was extremely moist and not overly sweet. 

The doordash driver was raving how cute it was inside so I definitely want to go and check it out. 

My only advice to the establishment is to allow flavors on doordash in the iced lattes and allow for special instructions to orders!

Who would fly to New Orleans & search out a middle eastern place to eat? I WOULD. 
Saba's blew my skirt up!
A Must, A Must, A Must. Ask for Heather!

Very good cheesesteak and cleaner than the original spots without the lines and much closer to home than Philly lol. As a NY transplant I should probably just stick in my lane with the pizza and wings, but cheesesteaks are my thing, esp when I was pregnant (i was actually a veg when I became pregnant with my son and it was one of my major cravings). So much for that lol. My husband isn't quite the fanatic, but thankfully he is a good sport. The rolls were so fresh. Very fluffy and delicious. The Bucks I ordered plain, I should have done the cheeze whiz, but ordered the cheesesteak fries and didnt want to over do it. Overall enjoyed and it was fast too. Will certainly be back!

Had the steak hoagie. It was good. 

We ate inside but the place is more of a to go place. 

Had a great conversation with each other the owners, which were very nice.

Highly recommended this place

Great to support a small and local business 

Will come back and try the pizza next time.

This restaurant is located inside the AdventHealth Center Ice rink.  However, it is a full service restaurant with bar and the menu is fantastic.  Not your typical burgers and fries (even though they have that!).   I love their wings (all the flavors) and anything with their pulled pork.  I've had almost everything on their menu and nothing disappoints.

Great BBQ!  Tri-up was fantastic, brisket and ribs were very tasty!  Mac and cheese and beans were good. Definitely will be returning quite often!  Waitress was so helpful and enthusiastic in her recommendations. Great service..I highly recommend.

What an awesome spot! They have a huge, well organized game selection organized by type of game, difficulty level,  etc.   I haven't been to a dedicated game shop with no play fee, this place was a very pleasant surprise.   They had a nice selection of beers on draft + cans, as well as a coffee bar. Great space, cute/ clean bathrooms,  overall a wonderful hang out spot. Very impressed!

Went here for lunch while visiting NOLA. Stopped in this place because it was enough to seat our 20 ppl party. The wait was a bit because we had a large party. The food was good. We ordered the queso blanco dip and it was very flavorful. Everyone said their good was really good. Glad we walked up on this place and decided to stop in.

If this is what your city is known for you need to do better.  

Tried the WIZ Cheesesteak from Geno's so wanted to Try Provolone from Pats.  

$12 for this.  

Don't waste your time go to Wawa instead and get a Cheesesteak - They're 100 times better or go make your own.

Liked the savory bun (which in fact was savory-sweet). The sweet bun was too sweet to my taste. Not willing to slice bread, and used COVID as an excuse though that doesn't make any sense.  For the amount payed they should slice the bread.

Wanted to grab a quick drink before a 4 hour drive home. The prices for the boba drinks were WAY more than I'm used to. $6 for a 24 oz and $7.50 for a 32 oz. I ordered 3 drinks regardless, because I wasnt gonna go find another place with my baby sleeping in the car. It took about 15-20 minutes for our drinks and no one else was in the store but me and my mom. The drink itself was very "watery" and not very slushy like I wanted. They were probably low on ice or something because our drinks had barely any blended ice. I wouldnt go here again, and wouldnt recommend this place. Sorry.

Agostino's is a wonderful Italian restaurant. When entering we were immediately greeted with a wonderful smile and seated right away. The restaurant is well lit and there's a beautiful Italian style decor. 
Our waitress greeted us immediately and told us about the Specials of the Day. The waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu, and very polite. 
I ordered the seafood pasta which was simply AWESOME. I will be going back and ordering the exact samething soon. 
However after ordering food, it took a little longer than I thought it should've taken, but it was well worth the wait. 
This is a restaurant you'll be very happy to visit over and over again.

Originally from Jersey but back visiting for a little bit and Mission Bbq was recommended to me by a Teller at a Chase Bank on Hwy 70. All I can say is thank you!!!! My Mom and I went to this location and I was impressed as soon as we walked in. I saw the awesome support for military and Law Enforcement in the business, I proudly represent both. Anyways, the Staff were very friendly. I ordered a brisket sandwich with Mac n cheese my Ma got brisket with a sweet potato and green beans. Both of our meals were outstanding!!!! 

My only regret is I wish there was one close to me where I live!!! An establishment like this would get my business as a regular. Great job Mission BBQ!!! Thank you for the support of our military and L.E.O.'s !!

Not knowledgeable about food sensitivities.

My husband ordered 3 tacos (which come in flour) and I ordered 3 tacos on corn.

When they arrived I questioned mine because they were puffy.  I asked if they were corn, was told yes, and asked if they were gluten free, thinking they could be a hybrid.  Server was very unsure and went to the kitchen to ask.  When he came back he told me they were gluten free.

After eating a taco I noticed one of my tacos was wrong.  Then looked more at my husbands, and noticed his looked more like corn.  They didn't swap our order exactly, they had most of the things we ordered but left one off and doubled a different one.  So it wasn't obvious that he had corn and I had flour.  I ordered one shrimp and that was on the flour plate.  And when questioned I was told the flour was corn.  Also I verified at the beginning and end of my order that I wanted corn.

When the guy came back with my corrected taco (still on flour) I asked him to verify which was flour and which was corn.  He told me mine was corn and then seemed unsure.  Asked for someone else to come to the table.  Someone else came told me I had flour and my husband had corn.

I got up to leave because I will be sick soon.  My husband explained to the young guy that gluten makes gluten free people sick.  The young guy didn't seem rude but he had never obviously never been taught anything allergies, ever.  The other guy did not offer any kind of apology.  No one seemed to care.

Bummed that I

Extremely unprofessional and filthy! There were small, flying insects everywhere and out of the 10 employees I saw, only one had on a hair net and she was out in the dining room sweeping. As I waited to check out, the young cashier was on her phone. I will not be back and do not recommend.

Service is really fast but there's always really bad 2000s music playing. Really fun for one drink but not to stay long. Get the hurricane if you're trying to get really buzzed! It's their most popular drink

OmGoodness!! The breakfast was soooooooo good. I came in here to get a cup of coffee to go. The customer service was great, one of the servers motioned for me to come around to the counter area for creamer, that was very kind of her to do so. An average breakfast joint would have just thrown the creamer n sugar in a bag n sent you on your way. She went the extra mile and they gained a customer for life. As I walked around I was eyeballing all the plates. Immediately I wanted to sit down and eat. I am the most picky eater on the planet. I will starve all day before I eat just anything. Arts Skillet is a hidden gem that everyone should know about. I ordered the biscuits and gravy with eggs and hash browns. I didn't need salt, pepper or ketchup.... it was perfect. I ate every bite, something I rarely do. I plan to tell everyone I know to come here for breakfast from now on.
Very crappy cheesesteaks and nothing but tourists. Also very crappy workers, I'm sure that's their number one specialty though.

I love Thai food however finding something as authentic as actually going to Thailand was very difficult. Upon first visit here I was reminded of Thailand- the photo of the current king, the decor, the overall familial vibe was pleasant to take in. The pad Thai chicken was AMAZING! I love the sisters there, they're very friendly and one told me to call her Auntie lol. I will certainly continue to support this awesome establishment
Good fast food Mexican place. Haven't tried CA mexican food on Fairview yet. I might do that today since they're closed here the holiday.

The owner is the server and host. He is phenomenal! He is so friendly and welcoming! He was gracious in his tight accommodation. He was super sweet!!! I was not expecting the restaurant to be so fancy! We thought they were having a wedding but it's just how fancy they keep the place! The use paper on top of the tables to remove them after each use, like when you go to the doctor. Hands sanitizer and wipes is a must at the front door. I just love them! Great people, great food! See y'all again next time!o

Went here for lunch today, and I have to say I was absolutely blown away. Not only was the outdoor atmosphere absolutely beautiful, and that it was great to be surrounded by great people and their dogs, but the food itself was delicious! I got the Beer Battered Fish and Chips, which was amazing, and my partner received the Ceaser Kale Salad (I think, for sure a salad) which was equally as great! 

Will be going back!

My boyfriend took me here on one of our date nights and it was a good time. The atmosphere is a little rustic, you can tell it's very much a local bar scene but the service was nice and the food...THE FOOD was delicious. I ordered the shrimp pasta and he and I shared the bang bang shrimp tacos-lit. I've ordered the bourbon burger twice through UberEats and each time it's been tasty. Definitely would recommend for anyone who might be gracing some comfort bar food or if you're looking for a good burger.

I had high hopes based on the reviews.  It wasn't the best. It wasn't the worst.  Our server was very friendly and attentive, but didn't hover, which I appreciate.  The salsa is very thick and too sweet for my taste, but it was tasty. I prefer a simple pico de gallo.  The steak in my burrito was a bit tough, but the other flavors weren't bad.  Just not as good as I expected based on the glowing reviews.

My former roommates are big fans of this place. My partner and I had never been, so we tagged along for Sunday lunch. The place was decently full around 1 pm, and the customers socially distanced themselves on their own. That was cool. Even more cool was the staff ALL wearing masks and gloves, and really cleaning well after a table was vacated. You can definitely eat here with confidence! Now for the food. I'd say it was a step above "run of the mill." It was good, don't get me wrong, but I didn't have anything that really stood out for me, short of the sweet Thai chili sauce that was served with our alligator bites appetizer. I had the half and half special (maybe it's  the 50/50 special?) which was a cup of seafood gumbo (pretty good stuff, that! Plus, you get your choice of any of the soups!) and half a po'boy. I had the soft shell crab po-boy which was ok. I tend to go for something spicy with a definite kick, but this unfortunately didn't deliver it. I could have poured on some hot sauce, but that didn't seem to be the answer. I asked for some remoulade, which made it better, but it still lacked something, not sure what. My partner had the catfish platter. When I asked him how it was, he shrugged and said, "Catfish is catfish." Again, nothing to make it stand out. Also, he ordered some jambalaya, and the girl ringing up the order actually repeated it to him, but still neglected to add it to our order. (How does THAT work?!) When the server brought the food, my partner me

Can you say YUM!! This adorable little building has some delicious food. The service was quick and friendly; the food was incredible. I started off with a vanilla latte and it was so good. The flavor of the coffee was just what my heart needed. It wasn't too strong and had just the right amount of vanilla. The menu has tons of great crepe options for those wanting something sweet or savory, but I opted for the breakfast croissant. It had ham, tomato, gruyere cheese, and an egg all on a yummy warmed croissant. I got the side of grits, and I'm telling you these were the best grits I think I have had in my lifetime. They were definitely something to write home about!! They were creamy and just the right amount of flavor. I was incredibly impressed. If I was going to be in NOLA for a little longer, I would definitely be back to this little cafe.
Everything was good. Highly recommend!! Gumbo and stinky soup was great. But you might want to make a reservation, it gets crowded easily.
We come here at least twice when visiting Santa Barbara for the weekend. Service is great and food is outstanding!

Ummmmm, wow!  I LOVE these wings and fried pickles!  They literally must have the Sponge Bob of fry cooks here  Amazing, crispy wings with multiple sauce options.  So good!  - Beers are very good too.  I really don't review unless I have something to share.  Loved my experience here during COVID, and nice people. Good food. 

My wife also has the grain bowl. That was tasty too. Not my speed but worth it for a few bites from me too!

Fries are soggy at this location consistently.  Sad.  I don't mind the wait in drive-thru if only my fries weren't hot and soggy.   Maybe leave them in the fryer a bit longer?   Or is the oil not hot enough? Else, no major complaints.  My food is usually correct, but the fries consistently disappoint us.

It's a shame we won't be going here because the food I've gotten is good. HOWEVER, none of the employees wear their masks which is very concerning. We have immuno-compromised family members so it's not worth it to us. We did have a situation where half our meal was incorrect. We ordered 3 of the same wrap and only got one. And yes all the other reviews are accurate. They take forever to deliver so it was very disappointing. We waited about over an hour for them to deliver the correct wraps.
What can I say " In and Out is what a burger is all about ". Accurate orders, polite staff. Amazing efficiency.

Absolutely superb! Service, food, ambiance - this place is an all-around WIN. Our server, Jeff, was wonderful. He was extremely knowledgable about the menu and wine list. He gave us an excellent Pinot Noir recommendation - we ended up ordering a bottle! All of the cocktails are great, but the seasonal summer cocktail is dangerously delicious. Portions are generous and pack a flavorful punch. I've never been disappointed with a trip to Anthony's.
I love they pizza it's so good sometimes it's cold sometimes it's hot sometimes they Alfredo pasta is watery but beside that I love it

The service was AWFUL. We were put upstairs and forgotten about. Had to get our own drinks and then go ask for our bill. When our issue was brought to the attention of a young lady that represented herself as the manager , her exact response was that they were busy. I asked why put someone in an area that the will be forgotten about. No offer of discount or future visit discount. We will never go back. Prodigy Burger is just around the corner!

Today was my second visit. First time was okay but service was better. That said I sat outside because the weather was beautiful. Server was a Caucasian young lady late teens early twenties at best. Simply put she sucked. Pros- hummus, tabouli and the lemonade smoothie. Cons- service and chicken shawarma plate. Who wants to eat visibly dry chicken and rice? Not me, especially given my ravenous appetite today. First plate I sent back and the second plate was not remarkably better. No discount no apologies and when I asked the silly server if the chicken is normally dry she said "she didn't know." That led me to my next question are you new, to which she responded no she has been there for a year now. Then came time to pay at which time she brought the check and told me I would need to pay inside.... no real biggie other than a minor inconvenience when I'm "dining in." What really irritated my core is when I entered the inside to pay I was told by the younger African American male hostess that my server would be up shortly to cash me out. I had to wait several minutes for Fatima to come from the back and cash me out. Mind you she was not my server but the server approached as I was leaving a more than generous $2 tip. This place needs to review their processes and food quality. I won't be back. Dine at your own risk. Ps - while the bread was okay it was not warm.......... odd. I will stick to Ranoush where the service and food quality meets or exceeds standards. Goodnight!

Oh my goodness! This was the worst experience ever and I wish I hadn't ordered anything. Our waitress was a small brunette, so sassy and rude. Went on a Sunday night with a reservation for 8 for a friends birthday. We sat for 42 minuets before our order was taken (it wasn't busy) we had to ask the waitress if we could order and all we got was "oh you're ready?". Plates of food were put in front of the wrong person. Over priced and really small menu. Food isn't good for anything other than a picture. I would save yourself the time and go elsewhere. I was expecting it to be awesome because of the cool games and photo station. Very overrated and annoying too good hipster vibes. Our waitress couldn't be bothered by our request. Not pleasant and will never come back :(

I have been to Pythian Market a handful of times now, but I wanted to share my WONDERFUL experience hosting my rehearsal dinner at the market. We had an awesome, partially secluded area reserved for us that worked out well. Each guest got a gift card & they could choose their own adventure for dinner. This was exactly what we wanted for our two families that were just meeting each other & everyone said the food was incredible & had a great time. The two staffers with us that night were SO great. Michael and Lauren made sure everything went smoothly and helped us out when we had a small hiccup with the gift cards.
